The batteries-included agent harness.


Deep Agents is an open source agent harness â an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece. **Principles:** - **Opinionated** â defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work - **Extensible** â override or replace any piece without forking - **Model-agnostic** â works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local - **Production-ready** â built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith **Features include:** - **Sub-agents** â delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows - **Filesystem** â read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends - **Context management** â summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk - **Shell access** â run commands in your sandbox of choice - **Persistent memory** â pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall - **Human-in-the-loop** â approve, edit, or reject tool calls before they run - **Skills** â reusable behaviors the agent can load on demand - **Tools** â bring your own functions or any MCP server Deep Agents is available as a JavaScript/TypeScript library â see [deepagents.js](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagentsjs). > [!NOTE] > **Deep Agents Code** â a pre-built coding agent in your terminal, similar to Claude Code or Cursor, powered by any LLM. Install with `curl -LsSf https://langch.in/dcode | bash`.
